children: Host Digital entered into a Registration Rights Agreement with certain stockholders in connection with recently issued restricted stock. The agreement requires the company to file a Rule 415 shelf registration statement within 30 days following Sep 17, 2026, to register up to 342,864 shares for resale and to keep it effective until all such shares are sold. Host Digital will cover certain holder expenses and provide customary indemnification, facilitating liquidity for recipients of the restricted stock.
: Registration Rights Agreement for resale of up to 342,864 shares of common stock
: Until all registrable securities are sold
: Provide liquidity for recipients of restricted stock
